scope: Reasoning cases; no executable golden behavior for undefined C

cases.premise: Actual struct cpf_clock uses all-SC atomic fields, one writer, retirement before wrap.
cases.claim: Replacing all operations with relaxed operations preserves the proof automatically.

cases.premise: The selected linked M4 image has no undefined symbols after dead-section collection.
cases.claim: All branches of every compiled source comply with the target runtime profile.

cases.premise: Seven QEMU MPS2 IRQ observations fit recorded acquisition brackets.
cases.claim: Their maximum is a worst-case physical ISR latency bound.

cases.premise: A qualified board capture identifies exact firmware, clock, route, raw trace, analyzer uncertainty and measured workload.
cases.claim: The trace establishes observed intervals for that setup under those assumptions.

cases.premise: The board revision changes but the source still compiles.
cases.claim: Prior physical timing and errata conclusions transfer unchanged.

cases.premise: A DMA buffer moves into CCM which the qualified DMA route cannot access.
cases.claim: Unchanged pointer type and successful linkage preserve transfer correctness.

cases.premise: Source includes no hosted C header.
cases.claim: Generated code cannot import an implicit compiler helper.

cases.premise: Every dequeued record contains a coherent timestamp.

deliverable: For each claim give a verdict, premises used, a counterexample when false, and the precise evidence or experiment needed. Do not promote one evidence category to another.
